invariants.rationale: The method always returns 'map', which is presumably constructed or loaded, so result should not be null.
An AssetManager is generally required for resource loading; passing null likely does not make sense and is not checked in the method.
The method requires a FileHandle to load the map, and no null check is present, so file is expected to be non-null.
fileName is used to identify the file being loaded; it is expected to be non-null.
If parameter is non-null, its textureMinFilter and textureMagFilter are accessed and used, so they must also be non-null.
